settings_notification_hint: Notices do not take focus or block mouse input. Animations follow Windows settings.
tip_lock_key_selection: Show changes for this key only. Turning off notifications preserves your selection
tip_notification_fullscreen: Hide lock key notices during fullscreen apps or presentations without replaying them later. System-action countdown warnings are unaffected
tip_notification_preview: Show a Caps Lock On sample without changing the real key state or saving settings
tip_lock_keys: Show Caps Lock, Num Lock and Scroll Lock changes without taking focus. Follows Windows animation settings
tip_pause_on_lock: Pause Stay Awake while the workstation is locked and resume on unlock; the saved switch is not changed
msg_idle_warning: %s in %d seconds. Move the mouse, press any key, or close this notice to cancel.
msg_autostart_disabled: IdleTrigger will no longer start with Windows.
cli_usage:
Usage: IdleTrigger <command>

Commands:
  sleep        Put the PC to sleep
  hibernate    Hibernate the PC
  shutdown     Shut down Windows
  restart      Restart Windows
  lock         Lock the workstation
  logoff       Log off the current session
  screen off   Turn off the display
  nosleep      Stay Awake (on|off|toggle|status)
  monitor      Idle Monitoring (on|off|toggle|status)
  autostart    Start with Windows (enable|disable|status)
  config:reload Reload the running tray configuration
  status       Show current status
  version      Show version
cli_error_sleep_unavailable: Sleep is not available on this system.
cli_error_hibernate_unavailable: Hibernation is not available on this system.
cli_error_tray_not_running: The tray application is not running.
warning_config_fields: Some settings had invalid types and were reset to defaults: %s. Saving once from Settings repairs the file.
warning_config_defaults: Warning: failed to load the configuration; using defaults:
warning_config_recovery: The original configuration file was not overwritten. Repair or delete it, then reload the configuration.
cli_unknown: Unknown command. Run without arguments to start the tray icon.
tip_quick_actions: Lock, sleep, hibernate, shut down, or restart. Save your work first
tip_nosleep: Prevent the PC from sleeping automatically while idle. Enabling this turns off manual idle monitoring; manual sleep or hibernate still works
tip_idle: Run the selected action after the set time without keyboard or mouse input. Enabling this turns off manual Stay Awake; an automatic Stay Awake task pauses it temporarily and it resumes when that task ends
tip_idle_enhanced: Use when a device or app repeatedly resets Windows idle time. Normal keyboard and mouse input still resets the timer
tip_idle_timeout: Choose how long keyboard and mouse input must remain idle before the action runs
tip_idle_action: Choose lock, sleep, hibernate, shut down, or restart after the idle time is reached
tip_theme: Switch Windows light/dark theme by fixed times or sunrise/sunset using the Windows time zone or optional approximate IP location
tip_fullscreen: Pause automatic theme switching during fullscreen apps, presentations, or foreground game activity
tip_theme_wallpaper: Applied together with the light/dark switch; leave empty to keep the wallpaper unchanged
tip_theme_cursor: An installed pointer scheme applied together with the light/dark switch; No linkage keeps it unchanged
tip_battery_theme: Use dark mode on battery; restore the schedule on AC power
tip_theme_switch: Switch between Windows light and dark themes; when auto switching is enabled, keep this choice until the next scheduled transition
tip_theme_repair: Repair the current theme when some windows or displays did not update; this does not change light/dark mode or the schedule
tip_hotkeys: Ctrl+Win+Shift+S sleep; Win+Shift+L lock; Win+Shift+N toggles Stay Awake; Win+Shift+D switches day/night
tip_autostart: Start in the tray after Windows sign-in; repair the path automatically
tip_logging: Write diagnostics to IdleTrigger.log. Keep this off normally
tip_language: Apply the selected language when you save settings
tip_settings: Adjust power, idle monitoring, day/night theme, and application preferences
tip_project_home: Open the IdleTrigger GitHub project in your default browser
tip_exit: Exit the tray app and stop all active features
tip_automation: Create time- or process-triggered tasks for Stay Awake, idle monitoring, and system actions. Battery and feature-conflict settings still apply
automation_empty_body: Select New to create your first task.
automation_name_hint: Optional; leave blank to generate it from these settings.
automation_event_skipped_busy: Skipped "%s": another action countdown was already running
automation_no_action_options: This action has no additional options.
automation_runtime_note: State changes are temporary; tasks need IdleTrigger running; system actions can be cancelled.
automation_changed_external: Tasks changed outside this window. Discard this edit to load the latest version.
automation_discard_confirm: Your changes have not been saved. Discard them and return to the task list?
automation_error_process_required: Choose at least one process for this trigger.
automation_error_date: Enter a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
automation_error_time: Enter a valid time in HH:MM format.
automation_error_end_time: Enter a valid end time in HH:MM format.
settings_description: Configure feature behavior and application preferences
settings_appearance_hint: Wallpaper and cursor schemes apply together with every day/night switch; leave a field empty to leave it unchanged
settings_keep_screen: Keep the display on while staying awake
settings_battery_allowed: Allow Stay Awake while on battery
settings_power_hint: A zero battery threshold disables the battery limit
settings_theme_hint: Location is used only to calculate local sunrise and sunset; IP results are cached in memory only
settings_location_ip_not_requested: IP lookup has not started; fallback: %s
settings_error_battery_threshold: Enter a battery level from 0 to 100.
settings_error_idle_timeout: Enter an idle timeout from 1 to 10080 minutes.
settings_error_warning_seconds: Enter a warning time from 10 to 3600 seconds.
settings_error_light_time: Enter the light time as HH:MM.
settings_error_dark_time: Enter the dark time as HH:MM.
settings_discard_confirm: Your unsaved settings will be lost.
settings_save_conflict: The configuration changed elsewhere. Close and reopen Settings before saving.
settings_system_apply_failed: Settings were saved, but Windows could not apply these options: %s. Please retry.
theme_repair_no_theme_file: The current Windows theme file is missing, so repair cannot run. Switch themes once in Windows Personalization settings (so a theme file exists) and try again
tip_nosleep_battery: Allow Stay Awake to continue on battery power. When off, it runs only while connected to AC power
tip_nosleep_battery_threshold: Stop Stay Awake below this battery percentage. Enter 0 for no minimum battery level
tip_idle_warning_seconds: Show a cancellable countdown before the idle action, 10 seconds minimum
tip_theme_mode: Use fixed times or calculate the light and dark schedule from sunrise and sunset at the selected location
tip_theme_light_time: The 24-hour time when the fixed schedule switches to light mode, in HH:MM format
tip_theme_dark_time: The 24-hour time when the fixed schedule switches to dark mode, in HH:MM format
tip_theme_location_source: Windows time zone works offline; IP location uses ipwho.is for an approximate city and falls back to the time zone when unavailable
tip_theme_location_status: Previews the selected location source; used for sunrise and sunset calculations after saving
tip_settings_cancel: Close Settings and discard changes that have not been saved
tip_settings_save: Validate and save all settings, then apply the changes immediately
tip_idle_manual_plan_warning: Manual plan: after %d idle minutes, run %s with a %d-second reminder
tip_automation_master: Pause all automatic tasks without deleting them
tip_automation_list: Shows each task and trigger. Double-click a task to edit it
tip_automation_toggle: Enable or disable the selected task
tip_automation_action: State actions apply only while their task condition is active. Pause never rewrites the manual toggle and is released when the condition ends. System actions use built-in features only; commands, scripts, and other apps are never launched
tip_automation_trigger: State actions can apply while processes run or during a time window. System actions can run on a schedule, when selected processes change from none running to any running, or after all selected processes exit
tip_automation_date: Date for a one-time task, in YYYY-MM-DD format
tip_automation_time: Enter a 24-hour time in HH:MM format
tip_automation_end_time: A state task ends when this time window closes
tip_automation_days: Choose one or more days when this task can run
tip_process_logic: Any needs one match; All needs every selected process
tip_choose_processes: Choose up to 64 running process names, or browse to a specific EXE file
tip_keep_screen: Stay Awake normally prevents system sleep only. Enable this to also keep the display on
tip_idle_minutes: Idle duration used when this task enables idle monitoring
tip_warning_seconds: Show a cancellable countdown of at least 10 seconds before any system action
tip_blocked_policy: At the scheduled time, skip or wait if the process condition is not met
tip_max_wait: How long to wait for the condition. Used only with Wait until allowed
process_picker_helper: A process name matches every same-name instance. You can also browse to a specific EXE file.
process_picker_invalid_exe: The selected file is not a valid Windows EXE file.
process_picker_loading_descriptions: The list is ready. Loading descriptions…
process_picker_privacy: Reads process names and EXE descriptions. PIDs aren't saved; files are never launched.
process_picker_error: Could not read the process list: %s
process_picker_limit: You can select up to %d process targets. Remove one before adding another.
process_picker_empty: No processes are available. Refresh in a moment.
process_picker_no_results: No matches. Clear the search and try again.
tip_process_search: Filter this list by process name or description
tip_process_refresh: Scan current processes now without clearing selections. The list also refreshes when this window becomes active again
tip_process_browse: Choose a specific EXE file for matching. The file is never launched
tip_process_cancel: Close without changing the process selection
tip_process_confirm: Save up to 64 process targets. PIDs are never stored
